description:
End of Day Music | Santoor Instrumental | 1.5 Hours

The workday is finally done. Time to let the evening become its own thing.

Not sleep yet, not forcing relaxation, not pushing into the next thing. Just the natural pause between the end of the day and whatever comes next. This is music for that quiet hour — soft enough to fill the background, present enough to mark the transition.

This is 90 minutes of Santoor in Raga Bhairavi — a deeply warm, grounding evening raga. The Santoor is a hammered dulcimer: each note is struck and then allowed to ring out and fade. The strikes give it a gentle, natural rhythm; the ringing gives it space. Together it sounds like the day quietly settling, with nothing left to do.

Put it on while you cook, while you change out of work clothes, while you sit with the first quiet of the evening.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Santoor — bright struck tones that bloom into warm ringing sustain
- Raga Bhairavi — a warm, grounding evening raga
- Soft tanpura drone underneath, holding the calm
- Very light tabla, sparse and unhurried
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning, with a soft theta undertone

⏱ Chapters
0:00    The day ending
20:00   Letting the work fall away
45:00   The quiet middle
70:00   Settling into the evening
85:00   Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play and stop reaching for things. No need to meditate or focus. Just let the music mark the boundary between the day and the evening.

⏱ Best for:
• Marking the end of the workday
• Quiet evenings with no plans
• Cooking, changing, settling in
• Replacing the news/scroll with something that closes the day
• Gentle background while you let the day end
